newsitem.title: MOROCCO: MOROCCAN AIRLINE LIFTS SEAT CAPACITY.
newsitem.headline: MOROCCAN AIRLINE LIFTS SEAT CAPACITY.

text.p: Morocco's state airline, Royal Air Maroc, said on Wednesday it had increased its seat capacity on international flights by 10.2 percent after reorganising frequencies.
The national carrier also said in a statement it had increased seat capacity by 15.3 percent on domestic routes.

"Since April 1, 1997, Royal Air Maroc is scheduling all its flights in the framework of a new network developed around Casablanca as the platform for its programme enabling the optimisation of links on domestic and international routes," it said.
